ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Timken India Limited reported healthy year-over-year growth for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, with revenue from operations increasing by 14.8% and net profit after tax rising by 10.5%, though both metrics experienced a sequential decline from the previous quarter. The unaudited financial results received an unmodified limited review opinion from Deloitte Haskins & Sells LLP. Minor organizational restructuring led to three individuals ceasing to be part of Senior Management Persons, but they remain employed by the company.
